challenge.name: Pure Poetry
challenge.difficulty_indicator: 200 source points; not treated as difficulty estimate

configuration.verifier: SHA-256 checked outside solver workspace; expected digest omitted

interpretation: One bounded Luna Medium development attempt through the CLI; no model escalation or retry. Record wall stop separately from solver failure.

correction: The prior STOPPED_UNSOLVED result combined the solver outcome and execution interruption. Reclassify it as ENVIRONMENT_INTERRUPTED (not an ordinary solver failure): the external stop was triggered after temporary-filesystem exhaustion blocked workspace operations. Keep the original status and details immutable; do not count it as an unsolved solver attempt in solve-rate estimates.

failures: No final flag candidate was produced; controller independently accepted no flag.
A PROGRESS.md shell append failed due quoting and a Python probe failed with a syntax error; both were command-level errors, and later solver probes continued.

The solver identified an ASCII Rez VECTOR:ICON containing an ncif vector payload and made structured-record probes, but did not decode/render it into the key within two rounds. Existing focused references cover image/steganography and HFS resource forks, not this classic Mac vector-icon encoding.
root_cause: Solving/tooling knowledge gap for the legacy Rez/ncif vector icon format. No storage, timeout, network, or service failure occurred. Tool discovery found no relevant local icon/resource decoder among the queried commands. This development case is not a held-out evaluation and this single result does not justify changing the canonical skill or controller.

preflight.storage: passed; monitor remained well above reserve

interpretation: Clean bounded experiment completed, but no verified solve. Next measurable opportunity: establish a reusable, provenance-backed Rez/ncif decoding path/tooling diagnostic and validate it on a separate development fixture before any skill change or repeat of this challenge.

correction: The source answer JSON was outside the solver workspace and its answer/digest were absent from workspace and saved logs, and no trace shows the solver opening it. However, the run trace shows the SDK shell could read a user memory file outside the workspace. Therefore mode 0600 and path separation did not prove an OS-level deny on reading the private answer JSON. Classify this as an integrity-limited development attempt, exclude it from strict verifier-isolation solve-rate evidence, and do not claim the solver was technically unable to access the host file. A future run must put verifier material behind a separate UID/container/mount policy and demonstrate the solver process cannot read it.

reason: Temporary-filesystem exhaustion triggered the external process stop; this is not an ordinary solver failure.
Host-level read denial of verifier material was not established; no solver read was observed and no candidate was produced.
Use the CLI's immediate pre-run statfs observation (5,332,221,952 bytes); the pre-registration probe was an earlier sample and is not the run-start measurement.

Ghidra was available but project setup/analysis was slow; one command invocation used incorrect environment assignment, then a corrected timeout-bounded analysis began.

root_cause: Not a completed solver failure: the runner reached its 240-second hard stop during the second of two persistent rounds. Reclassify as environment-interrupted and exclude from solve-rate denominator. Useful development signals: environment-specific 32-bit execution needs, costly static analysis setup, challenge demands multi-check reverse engineering.
interpretation: Distinct NYU development-split reverse case; no test-split material used. No retry or model escalation. Not a held-out evaluation and no solve improvement claim. Source answer, digest, verifier files and reference solution were not exposed to solver. Safe telemetry/state and their hashes are in docs/reports/experiments/EXP-2026-10-29-NYU-PALO-ALTO/.
